offering_description.value: Provides engineering, technical, program management and operations and maintenance services to government agencies and some commercial clients. Work spans defense, space, nuclear cleanup, intelligence, energy and critical infrastructure. Delivered through long-term contracts staffed by its own engineers and technicians.

primary_services.value: engineering and technical services; operations and maintenance; program management; environmental and nuclear remediation; systems integration and mission support

customer_segment.value: B2G: US Department of Defense, DOE, NASA, intelligence agencies, and allied governments; B2B: commercial energy, infrastructure and industrial clients, and prime contractors

end_markets.value: defense; space; nuclear and environmental cleanup; intelligence; energy and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: long-term government contracts, cost-plus, fixed-price and time-and-materials; service fees: operations, maintenance and technical support services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: supplies engineering and technical labor and expertise to government agencies and commercial clients

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Middle East, Asia-Pacific and other allied nations

specialization.value: related lines: engineering, technical services and operations support across defense, space, nuclear, intelligence and infrastructure

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bids and contracts with government agencies and corporate clients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: government contracting rules (FAR), security clearances, export controls, and nuclear safety rules (DOE, NRC)
